svg.text: Actual 447,500 original photographs · 4,475 taxa · 18 × 9 equal-area opportunity grid
Colour shown only where ≥20 species qualify
Log-scaled number of eligible species per cell
A cell qualifies at ≥10 classifiable photos and ≥3 observers per taxon; D measures photographed labels, not genetic morphs.
Exploratory. No wild/native ascertainment, historical range inference, or causal environmental effect. Source: FCP Actions #39412659475.
